description: Read existing scenarios/notification-hub/ (PRD.md, api/main.go, api/processor.go) and deleted packages/server/src/notify/ code (git commit cca5b23eed). Extract domain concepts worth preserving: multi-tenant profile model with API key isolation, contact/device management with per-channel preferences and verification status, 4-level priority system (low/normal/high/urgent) mapped to platform standards (APNs 5/10, FCM normal/high, Web Push RFC 8030 urgency), rate limiting tiers (per-profile, per-channel, hourly/daily/monthly, cost-based), template system with variable substitution and channel-specific content, notification lifecycle states (pending/queued/sending/sent/delivered/failed), unsubscribe scopes (all/per-channel/per-category), DND/quiet hours model (timezone-aware), delivery tracking and per-channel analytics. Output: domain model doc for greenfield rewrite. Do NOT preserve technical choices (n8n, Postgres/Redis, specific provider implementations).
name: notification-hub-signal-extraction
title: Extract Reusable Domain Signal From Legacy Notification Hub
